construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.
State report 2025, Table A2: deed restriction type inclusionary for the 2 moderate-income units; notes field reads "Private financing."
Stormland first proposed a five-story, 20-condominium building in 2022 (22PLN-00198); after council direction it was reduced to a three-story, 10-unit building around a central courtyard.

The Architectural Review Board supported the plan 4-1 in fall 2024 and the Planning and Transportation Commission forwarded it in February 2025. Ellis Partners, owner of adjacent Town & Country Village, opposed the project.

Tentative map 25PLN-00034 merges two lots for a ten-unit condominium subdivision on a 12,119 sq ft parcel; hearings listed: PTC 8/27/25 and Council tentative map 9/29/25. CEQA review relied on Section 15183 consistency with the Comprehensive Plan EIR (SCH 2014052101).
In November 2025 Ellis Partners filed a pre-application for 158 apartments in two seven-story buildings at 44 and 88 Encina Ave, flanking this site.
